elements.name: Toggle an origin plane while the active view is locked

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
the user copies the Primary view representation as BrowserView and activates BrowserView
The MCAD Software has an empty part with a copied view active
the YZ origin plane is hidden
the user chooses Lock from the active view context menu
the active view displays a lock indicator
the user chooses Visibility from the YZ origin plane context menu
the YZ origin plane is visible
Visibility is checked in the plane context menu
the active view still displays a lock indicator
the user chooses Visibility from the YZ origin plane context menu again
the YZ origin plane is hidden
the user chooses Lock from the active view context menu again
the active view no longer displays a lock indicator
